in_run_pair_suppliers.interface: The actual T13 theorem is for its Milstein discretization and commutative-noise hypotheses. Its moment/local defect/global recurrence claims do not directly provide BAOAB’s same-Brownian exact OU coupling, state-weighted local mean and second-moment defects, residual Lipschitz control, or the B/2–A/2–O–A/2 weak semigroup expansion. Those estimates are proved locally; the T13 page-level requires edge is left open.

The exact-flow definition and Lie/Strang local/global results apply to finite-dimensional deterministic C3 fields on compact tubes. They provide deterministic A/B composition context only. The O substep is a stochastic OU semigroup, and BAOAB weak order is established by the local generator composition proof; no T04 stochastic theorem is assumed.

external_page_requires.interface: The published ULA theorem proves the standard-normal target invariant variance 2/(2−η) for 0<η<2, from the exact ULA update. Only the B comparison example uses this formula; it is not transferred to the underdamped chain.

The local OU, stationarity, moment and weak-expansion arguments use the exact model/SDE, multidimensional Itô, and deterministic Itô Gaussian integral statements under their stated usual-filtration and moment hypotheses.

unresolved_suppliers.required_interface: If T13 is intended to supply the stochastic error interface, reconciliation needs an item whose assumptions cover the additive-noise underdamped drift with linear growth and globally bounded force derivatives, the BAOAB exact OU integral coupled to the same Brownian path, conditional one-step mean O(h^2(1+|z|)), conditional second moment O(h^3(1+|z|^2)), a same-noise O(h)-Lipschitz numerical residual, and the finite-horizon RMS recurrence. A weak interface would additionally need the five-factor B/2–A/2–O–A/2–B/2 generator expansion through h^2 with controlled h^3 remainder. Existing T13 claims do not provide these exact interfaces.
